info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Risk Models Retrieval API
info.description: The Operational Risk Models Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about various operational risk models used in banking. This endpoint allows consumers, such as risk management teams or financial analysts, to fetch specific models by providing relevant parameters. By integrating this API, organizations can enhance their risk assessment processes and ensure compliance with regulatory standards. The API supports improved decision-making and provides insights into operational risk management strategies.

get.description: Fetch the details of the specific operational risk model identified by RES-100045. This endpoint allows users to access all relevant information about the model for analysis and reporting purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of the operational risk model identified by RES-100045. Ensure to send the required data in JSON format as specified below.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the operational risk model.
